Toshi Vasistha

EMAIL: tvasistha@gmail.com, toshivasistha@ymail.com MOBILE: +91-8809596730

LinkedIn

Results-driven Cloud & DevOps Tech Lead with 11+ years of experience in designing, automating, and optimizing mission-critical infrastructures across Azure, AWS, and GCP. Proven track record in leading CI/CD implementations, Kubernetes (AKS, Rancher, K3s) deployments, Terraform-based Infrastructure as Code, and cloud security initiatives to drive operational excellence, cost efficiency, and innovation. Skilled in mentoring high-performing teams and enabling enterprise-scale digital transformation for global clients.  PROFILE SUMMARY

Cloud & DevOps Tech Lead with 11+ years of experience driving CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, and automation initiatives across global clients including Ticketmaster, Tesco, SCB, G4S, US Foods, and AT&T.

Cloud Platforms Expert with hands-on experience in Azure (AKS, VMSS, VNETs, Subnets, NSGs, NICs, Bastion, Blob Storage, Log Analytics, App Insights, Defender, Azure DevOps), AWS (EC2, Lambda, RDS, Route53, S3, IAM, CloudFront, API Gateway, Load Balancers), and GCP (App Engine, Cloud SQL, Pub/Sub, BigQuery).

Infrastructure as Code (IaC) Specialist, proficient in Terraform (authored reusable modules for Bastion, Syslog, VNETs, Storage, VMSS) and Helm, delivering repeatable, version-controlled deployments and performing critical Helm2 → Helm3 upgrades.

CI/CD & DevOps Leader, designing and maintaining automated pipelines with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, and Bitbucket to accelerate software delivery and enhance operational reliability.

Kubernetes & Containerization Expert, managing AKS, Rancher, and K3s clusters, microservices deployments, and Vault-based certificate rotation for enterprise-grade applications.

Monitoring & Observability Professional, implementing Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, App Insights, Prometheus, and Grafana to enable proactive incident detection, capacity planning, and performance optimization.

Security & Compliance Advocate, ensuring strict adherence to CCPA, GDPR, and enterprise security standards through encryption, audit readiness, and DevOps-aligned compliance practices.

CORE COMPETENCIES

DevOps Strategy & Implementation

Application Build & Release Management

Cost Optimization & Resource Right- sizing

Prometheus Monitoring & Alerting	Vault & Secrets Management	Configuration Management

Security & Compliance (CCPA, GDPR)

 SOFT SKILLS

Cloud Networking & Load Balancing

 EDUCATION

Helm Charts Management

AWARDS & ACHIEVEMENTS

Change Agent Collaborator

Communicator Innovator

Planner Thinker

B.Tech. in Production Engineering from Birla Institute Of Technology, Mesra (2010-2014) - 65%

 TECHNICAL SKILLS

Cloud Platforms: Azure (AKS, App Insights, Azure Monitor, Storage, Networking, Firewall), LA Workspace, VMSS, AWS (EKS, EC2, S3, IAM, Route 53, CloudFront, ALB/NLB), GCP (Compute Engine, GKE, Cloud Storage, IAM, VPC Networking)

Kubernetes & Rancher: Kubernetes (vanilla kubeadm clusters, AKS, EKS), Rancher (HA setup, Backup/DR, Fleet GitOps), K3s multi-node clusters (store-level edge deployments)

Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & Automation: Terraform (reusable modules, state management), Helm (chart customization & deployments)

CI/CD & DevOps Tools: Azure DevOps (pipelines, YAML automation, reporting), Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI

Achieved Client Appreciations – 2021

Pat on the Back Award – 2015

Observability & Monitoring: New Relic (agents, dashboards, meta- monitoring), Prometheus & Alertmanager, Grafana

Containers & Orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes

Programming / Scripting: Shell Scripting, YAML/JSON

Collaboration & Version Control: GitHub, GitLab, Confluence, Jira

WORK EXPERIENCE

 Publicis Sapient | Jun 2022 – Present	

Key Projects Handled:

HSBC WPB API – Senior Associate Infrastructure Engineer L1

Skills/Domain: Linux, AWS (S3, EC2, IAM, Route 53, API Gateway, CloudFront, Load Balancers), Terraform, Kubernetes, Docker, Prometheus, Grafana, GitLab, GitHub, Jenkins, Chef, Jira, Confluence, Mulesoft Gateway

Description: Part of HSBC’s Build Once Scale Fast (BOSF) program focusing on WPB API remediation, improving API standards, discoverability, and reducing cost/risk across the estate.

Key Contributions:

Sole DevOps engineer responsible for end-to-end infrastructure setup and CI/CD pipelines across Dev, QA, Pre-Prod, and Prod.

Deployed services as Kubernetes pods on AWS EKS and enabled Mulesoft Gateway for GraphQL APIs.

Implemented Splunk logging, documented deployment processes, and managed production Go-Live troubleshooting.

Acted as process architect to identify roadblocks, train developers, and create comprehensive knowledge repositories.

SCB SLA1 → SLA2 – DevOps Engineer

Skills/Domain: DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure (Azure/Huawei), CI/CD

Summary: Supported the SCBx CCoE initiative to centralize cloud adoption and migrate legacy systems to Azure and Huawei, ensuring alignment of IT capabilities with business objectives.

Key Achievements:

Spearheaded CI/CD initiatives by designing and operating Jenkins-based landing zone pipelines, standardizing onboarding and automation across multiple subsidiaries.

Implemented DevSecOps, semantic versioning, and microservice pipelines with integrated GitLab/Jira workflows, enhancing code quality and deployment reliability.

Developed reusable Terraform modules and templates, embedding shift-left testing to validate infrastructure components early in the pipeline.

Delivered a fully functional Syslog Server solution on Azure across SCB and subsidiaries, meeting critical cybersecurity compliance requirements.

Led a Proof of Concept (PoC) integrating DevSecOps tools into Terraform pipelines to detect vulnerabilities and enforce compliance standards effectively.

Tesco – Team Lead (SLA2), Finance Data Hub (FDH) Skills/Domain: DevOps, Azure Cloud, CI/CD, Terraform Summary:

Led the implementation of the Finance Data Hub (FDH) on Microsoft Azure, delivering a scalable and reusable data platform supporting multiple business domains. Focused on governance, compliance, and cost optimization while enabling faster and more reliable platform delivery.

Key Achievements:

Designed and deployed CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Workflows and Azure DevOps, automating both infrastructure provisioning and application deployment.

Defined the Terraform delivery strategy, incorporating reusable modules, remote state management, and shift-left testing for consistent, auditable, and reliable infrastructure.

Streamlined environment provisioning (DEV, PPE, PROD) with standardized Terraform templates, reducing deployment times and accelerating overall delivery cycles.

Partnered with cross-functional teams to build reusable platform assets, minimizing redundancy and ensuring scalability across Finance, Legal, and Property domains.

Tesco – Tech Lead, Safe & Secure Stores

Skills/Domain: Cloud Infrastructure, Kubernetes, Rancher, Ansible, Terraform, Azure DevOps, Observability Summary:

Leading the Safe & Secure Stores program, delivering secure retail store environments through advanced video intelligence and incident prevention platforms. Managing a 10-member engineering team responsible for Video Platform and Incident Prevention initiatives across global store operations.

Key Achievements:

Designed and deployed a fault-tolerant Rancher control plane with 3× stacked etcd masters and worker nodes, eliminating single points of failure while ensuring uninterrupted cluster management.

Implemented Rancher disaster recovery with Rancher Backup Operator, enabling automated snapshots and validated restore workflows to reduce recovery times and minimize data loss.

Strengthened etcd resilience with automated backups, compaction strategies, and quota tuning, ensuring stability for large-scale production clusters.

Built scalable multi-node K3s clusters with dedicated etcd persistent volumes to support both large-format and express stores, meeting high availability and disaster recovery requirements.

Reduced cluster setup time from 0.5 days to under 2 hours through infrastructure automation with Ansible and modular Terraform templates.

Developed Azure DevOps pipelines for automated cluster onboarding, reporting, and audit tracking, improving compliance and operational efficiency.

Standardized GitOps onboarding using Rancher Fleet, streamlining bundle deployment and drift detection across 4,000+ edge clusters.

Recognized meta-observability dashboards with New Relic integrations, enabling proactive control-plane monitoring, faster issue detection, and audit-driven insights.

 Ticketmaster, India | DevOps Engineer | Dec’2019 – Jun’2022	 Privacy Core – DevOps Engineer

Skills/Domain: GitLab, GitHub, Jira, Terraform, Confluence, Prometheus, Grafana, Kubernetes, Helm, AWS (Lambda, RDS, EC2, Route 53, IAM, S3), Vault, Docker

Description: Centralized platform for managing and fulfilling Data Subject Requests (DSRs) across Ticketmaster, Livenation, Ticketweb, Frontgate, and other brands to ensure compliance with CCPA and U.S. privacy regulations.

Key Contributions:

Implemented Prometheus alerting and Grafana dashboards for privacy applications.

Built and optimized GitLab CI/CD pipelines and AWS infrastructure with Terraform.

Upgraded Helm v2→v3 and rolled out infra patches/upgrades across Terraform, Kubernetes, Prometheus, and Grafana.

Integrated Vault sidecar containers for automated cert management and extended solution org-wide.

Secured sensitive assets by encrypting Payment API credentials (TalonOne–CCPA).

Performed DevOps audits, resource right-sizing, and cost/security optimizations across Privacy Core, CDS, and GDPR.

Troubleshot Kubernetes workloads and piloted CPU/memory resource management.

Authored Confluence documentation and led technical knowledge-sharing sessions.

 G4S IT Services, India | DevOps Consultant | Oct’2018 – Dec’2019	

Administered Atlassian tools (Jira, Bitbucket, Confluence) and managed GCP components (IAM, PubSub, BigQuery, DataStore, Compute/ App Engine, Cloud SQL, Stackdriver).

Designed and deployed high-availability cloud infrastructure on GCP with load balancers and auto-scaling server groups.

Implemented CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins for microservices and payment gateway deployments.

Built and deployed applications on Google App Engine and Google Compute Engine, ensuring reliability and scalability.

Configured and managed MongoDB and Redis clusters with high availability for resilient data storage.

 HCL Infra (Client: US Foods) | Specialist / DevOps Consultant | Jan’2018 – Sep’2018	

Designed and automated infrastructure using Chef (server, workstation, nodes), managing cookbooks, recipes, and seamless deployments.

Integrated Bitbucket with ChefDK and automated cookbook uploads to Chef Server via Bamboo CI/CD pipelines.

Provisioned and maintained AWS services (VPC, EC2, S3, IAM, Route 53) to support enterprise-scale cloud infrastructure.

Set up and managed infrastructure for multiple POCs (e.g., R servers, Anaconda environments) to accelerate innovation.

Implemented secure and scalable storage solutions by creating and managing S3 buckets across AWS environments.

 Tech Mahindra (Client: AT&T) | Software Engineer (Build & Release / WebLogic Admin) | Oct’2014 – Jan’2018	

Installed, configured, and managed WebLogic servers on distributed clusters, integrating with web servers for high availability.

Automated build and deployment processes using Jenkins, Maven, Ant, and Shell scripting, reducing manual effort and deployment time.

Provided end-to-end application support (Prod, UAT, Dev) for major AT&T applications across desktop, mobile, SMB, and backend systems.

Authored SOPs/KOPs and stabilized support services with defined processes, ensuring audit and compliance readiness.

Led incident management, environment setup, and release planning (hot-fix, minor, and major deployments), coordinating with global teams for smooth delivery.

 KEY HIGHLIGHTS ACROSS CAREER

Delivered large-scale cloud and DevOps transformations across finance and retail domains, architecting fault-tolerant, highly available, and automated solutions on AWS, Azure, and private cloud platforms.

Led Tesco’s Safe Secure Store Program as Tech Lead, designing a high-availability Rancher setup (4000+ downstream clusters), architecting multi- node K3s clusters for large-format stores, and implementing Ansible- and Terraform-based automation that reduced provisioning time from hours to minutes.

Served as CI/CD SME for SCB’s CCoE Project, creating reusable Jenkins pipelines, Terraform modules, and delivering a cloud-based Syslog Server solution across SCB and subsidiaries—later showcased in technical community sessions.

Orchestrated automation in Tesco’s Finance Data Hub Program, building a Terraform-driven provisioning solution with GitHub workflows and CI/CD pipelines on Azure CSP, enabling rapid and reliable infrastructure rollout.

Consistently recognized for impact with multiple Core Value Awards at Publicis Sapient, including Partnering for Client Impact, Engaging with Openness, and Inclusive Collaboration.

Winner of “Howathon 2024” (EnggNext, Publicis Sapient) for building an AI-powered cloud architecture generator that converted designs into Terraform and deployed via GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines.

Active community leader and mentor: drives She Thrives on Cloud (women-in-tech initiative), leads the Azure Tribe community for Cloud & DevOps practitioners, delivers technical knowledge-sharing sessions, and advocates for diversity and inclusion in technology.

Experienced in GO-LIVE event leadership, environment orchestration, and troubleshooting under tight deadlines, ensuring smooth deployments and production stability.

Transitioned from Mechanical Engineer to DevOps Engineer, combining a problem-solving mindset with a passion for exploring new tools, technologies, and future-ready innovations.

Skills/Domain: GitLab, GitHub, Jira, Terraform, Confluence, Prometheus, Grafana, Kubernetes, Helm, AWS (Lambda, RDS, EC2, Route 53, IAM, S3), Vault, Docker
Description: Centralized platform for managing and fulfilling Data Subject Requests (DSRs) across Ticketmaster, Livenation, Ticketweb, Frontgate, and other brands to ensure compliance with CCPA and U.S. privacy regulations.
Key Contributions:
Implemented Prometheus alerting and Grafana dashboards for privacy applications.
Built and optimized GitLab CI/CD pipelines and AWS infrastructure with Terraform.
Upgraded Helm v2→v3 and rolled out infra patches/upgrades across Terraform, Kubernetes, Prometheus, and Grafana.
Integrated Vault sidecar containers for automated cert management and extended solution org-wide.
Secured sensitive assets by encrypting Payment API credentials (TalonOne–CCPA).
Performed DevOps audits, resource right-sizing, and cost/security optimizations across Privacy Core, CDS, and GDPR.
Troubleshot Kubernetes workloads and piloted CPU/memory resource management.
Authored Confluence documentation and led technical knowledge-sharing sessions.
 G4S IT Services, India | DevOps Consultant | Oct’2018 – Dec’2019	
Administered Atlassian tools (Jira, Bitbucket, Confluence) and managed GCP components (IAM, PubSub, BigQuery, DataStore, Compute/ App Engine, Cloud SQL, Stackdriver).
Designed and deployed high-availability cloud infrastructure on GCP with load balancers and auto-scaling server groups.
Implemented CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins for microservices and payment gateway deployments.
Built and deployed applications on Google App Engine and Google Compute Engine, ensuring reliability and scalability.
Configured and managed MongoDB and Redis clusters with high availability for resilient data storage.
 HCL Infra (Client: US Foods) | Specialist / DevOps Consultant | Jan’2018 – Sep’2018	
Designed and automated infrastructure using Chef (server, workstation, nodes), managing cookbooks, recipes, and seamless deployments.
Integrated Bitbucket with ChefDK and automated cookbook uploads to Chef Server via Bamboo CI/CD pipelines.
Provisioned and maintained AWS services (VPC, EC2, S3, IAM, Route 53) to support enterprise-scale cloud infrastructure.
Set up and managed infrastructure for multiple POCs (e.g., R servers, Anaconda environments) to accelerate innovation.
Implemented secure and scalable storage solutions by creating and managing S3 buckets across AWS environments.
 Tech Mahindra (Client: AT&T) | Software Engineer (Build & Release / WebLogic Admin) | Oct’2014 – Jan’2018	
Installed, configured, and managed WebLogic servers on distributed clusters, integrating with web servers for high availability.
Automated build and deployment processes using Jenkins, Maven, Ant, and Shell scripting, reducing manual effort and deployment time.
Provided end-to-end application support (Prod, UAT, Dev) for major AT&T applications across desktop, mobile, SMB, and backend systems.
Authored SOPs/KOPs and stabilized support services with defined processes, ensuring audit and compliance readiness.
Led incident management, environment setup, and release planning (hot-fix, minor, and major deployments), coordinating with global teams for smooth delivery.

sections.label: Summary
sections.text:
Summary: Supported the SCBx CCoE initiative to centralize cloud adoption and migrate legacy systems to Azure and Huawei, ensuring alignment of IT capabilities with business objectives.
Key Achievements:
Spearheaded CI/CD initiatives by designing and operating Jenkins-based landing zone pipelines, standardizing onboarding and automation across multiple subsidiaries.
Implemented DevSecOps, semantic versioning, and microservice pipelines with integrated GitLab/Jira workflows, enhancing code quality and deployment reliability.
Developed reusable Terraform modules and templates, embedding shift-left testing to validate infrastructure components early in the pipeline.
Delivered a fully functional Syslog Server solution on Azure across SCB and subsidiaries, meeting critical cybersecurity compliance requirements.
Led a Proof of Concept (PoC) integrating DevSecOps tools into Terraform pipelines to detect vulnerabilities and enforce compliance standards effectively.
Tesco – Team Lead (SLA2), Finance Data Hub (FDH) Skills/Domain: DevOps, Azure Cloud, CI/CD, Terraform Summary:
Led the implementation of the Finance Data Hub (FDH) on Microsoft Azure, delivering a scalable and reusable data platform supporting multiple business domains. Focused on governance, compliance, and cost optimization while enabling faster and more reliable platform delivery.
Key Achievements:
Designed and deployed CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Workflows and Azure DevOps, automating both infrastructure provisioning and application deployment.
Defined the Terraform delivery strategy, incorporating reusable modules, remote state management, and shift-left testing for consistent, auditable, and reliable infrastructure.
Streamlined environment provisioning (DEV, PPE, PROD) with standardized Terraform templates, reducing deployment times and accelerating overall delivery cycles.
Partnered with cross-functional teams to build reusable platform assets, minimizing redundancy and ensuring scalability across Finance, Legal, and Property domains.
Tesco – Tech Lead, Safe & Secure Stores
Skills/Domain: Cloud Infrastructure, Kubernetes, Rancher, Ansible, Terraform, Azure DevOps, Observability Summary:
Leading the Safe & Secure Stores program, delivering secure retail store environments through advanced video intelligence and incident prevention platforms. Managing a 10-member engineering team responsible for Video Platform and Incident Prevention initiatives across global store operations.
Key Achievements:
Designed and deployed a fault-tolerant Rancher control plane with 3× stacked etcd masters and worker nodes, eliminating single points of failure while ensuring uninterrupted cluster management.
Implemented Rancher disaster recovery with Rancher Backup Operator, enabling automated snapshots and validated restore workflows to reduce recovery times and minimize data loss.
Strengthened etcd resilience with automated backups, compaction strategies, and quota tuning, ensuring stability for large-scale production clusters.
Built scalable multi-node K3s clusters with dedicated etcd persistent volumes to support both large-format and express stores, meeting high availability and disaster recovery requirements.
Reduced cluster setup time from 0.5 days to under 2 hours through infrastructure automation with Ansible and modular Terraform templates.
Developed Azure DevOps pipelines for automated cluster onboarding, reporting, and audit tracking, improving compliance and operational efficiency.
Standardized GitOps onboarding using Rancher Fleet, streamlining bundle deployment and drift detection across 4,000+ edge clusters.
Recognized meta-observability dashboards with New Relic integrations, enabling proactive control-plane monitoring, faster issue detection, and audit-driven insights.
